item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00045","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C17","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both proclamations use the same compact sequence: identify a bilateral trade agreement entered under section 350(a), identify the proclamation that implemented it, recite a subsequent bilateral agreement fixing when the trade agreement ceases, recite the President's statutory termination authority, and terminate the implementing proclamation at the close of the preceding day. C17 and C08 employ closely related machinery, but their termination predicates depend on accession to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and therefore match the child's structure less exactly.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the President of the United States of America entered into a trade agreement with the President of the republic of Costa Rica on November 28, 1936 ... Whereas by Proclamation of July 3, 1937 ... the President proclaimed the said trade agreement","parent_excerpt":"the President of the United States of America entered into a trade agreement with the President of the Republic of Colombia on September 13, 1935 ... and proclaimed such trade agreement by proclamation dated April 20, 1936","explanation":"Both begin by identifying the bilateral agreement, its statutory basis, and the proclamation that put it into effect."},{"child_excerpt":"the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of Costa Rica entered into an agreement ... providing that the said trade agreement shall cease to be in force on and after June 1, 1951","parent_excerpt":"the Government of the United States of America has agreed with the Government of the Republic of Colombia that the said trade agreement shall cease to be in force on and after December 1, 1949","explanation":"This is distinctive parallel language describing bilateral agreement upon a precise cessation date."},{"child_excerpt":"section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, authorize[s] the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section","parent_excerpt":"the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes the President to terminate in whole or in part any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section","explanation":"The statutory-authority recital is essentially identical and occupies the same position immediately before the operative clause."},{"child_excerpt":"do proclaim that the said proclamation of July 3, 1937, is hereby terminated as of the close of May 31, 1951","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the said proclamation dated April 20, 1936, shall terminate and cease to have effect at the close of November 30, 1949","explanation":"Both operative clauses terminate the earlier implementing proclamation at the close of the day immediately preceding the agreed cessation date."}]}
